facilities.heading: Formal Hall
description: Located just in between first and second court, hall is one of college's prized possessions.

You can book tickets on uPay for a very reasonable price. Ordinarily, Johnians are allowed to purchase 2 additional guest tickets. If you want to bring more guests you can either seek dean approval or just ask a few mates to come with you.

facilities.heading: Old Music Room
description: Hosts a few choice events. The annual wine tasting takes palce in the old music room and is not one to miss.

facilities.heading: The JCR
description: Short for the Junior Combination Room, this is the one room in college dedicated exclusively to undergraduate students.
Come here for a big TV with BT Sport, Mario Kart and Fifa - to name but a few. If that isn't your cup of tea, you can also play with some pool, ping pong, darts or even a bit of table football

facilities.heading: The Bar
description: Pubs in Cambridge are expensive. There are however two exceptions: spoons and college bars. John's bar is a student favourite thanks to its cosy atmosphere and cheap pints.
If pints aren't your cup of tea, there is in fact also tea, and most other refreshments and an assortment of snacks and bites.

facilities.heading: The Buttery
description: If you have neither the desire nor the ability to cook. The buttery has you covered. This serves an informal breakfast, lunch and dinner every day. On saturdays the two are combined into a fan favourite brunch.
The buttery is very much the social hub of college. There will always be someone in the buttery.

facilities.heading: The Library
description: Does what is says on the tin.
Lots of books, very fast wifi and plenty of work to be getting on with - what more could you want? Don't answer that.

As well as the modern library, there is also the old library. This is that strange building you've never been into on the side of third court that overlooks the river. Few venture inside but it is oh so beautiful and home to our most prized books.

facilities.heading: The Chapel
description: An absolutely gorgeous area of college. The chapel is always a place for reflection or admiration.

A little known fact is that Johnians are allowed to ascend to the roof of the chapel during summer term. Inquire at forecourt plodge. The views are absolutely worth it. After all it is the tallest building in Cambridge.

facilities.heading: Forecourt Bike Shed
description: Though not in Chapel Court, this is right nextdoor to chapel court separated only by the plodge.
Forecourt is home to one of our two bike storage locations. The other is underneath Cripps.
Keep your bike in whichever is most convenient but remember to register it with the porters first.

facilities.heading: The Palmerston Room
description: One of the most miscellaneous but best rooms in college. It is a fully-sized badminton court but also has a stage and removable seating.
The Palmerston room also houses our famous Super Ents. Watch out for those.

facilities.heading: The Fisher Foyer
description: Hosts various events over the course of the year. However, it is best known as the OG Ent location.
Much fun has been had in the Fisher Foyer.

facilities.heading: Computer Room
description: A well-kept secret. On the top floor of the Fisher Building is a computer room. This houses various computers and some printers.
It's like the library but les sweat.

facilities.heading: Cripps Bike Shed
description: Much like it's counterpart in Forecourt you can keep your bike here. Pick whichever is most convenient.
Once again, remember to register your bike with the porters.

facilities.heading: The Fitness Centre
description: If you like staying fit, this is the place for you.
There are various machines for staying fit in this room. I do not know their names but I am told they are quite effective.
If somehing is missing/broken or you want something new contact our facilities officer: Tim D'Aboville (tgmd2)

facilities.heading: The Free Weights Room
description: Because one gym wasn't enough.
This is where you come to lift weights that are free, should you feel so inclined.
Again if anything ain't up to scratch talk to our facilities officer: Tim D'Aboville (tgmd2)

facilities.heading: The Snooker Room
description: A very underrated room in college. This houses a fully sized snooker table.
Sign out the keys from Cripps plodge and go get your 147s.

facilities.heading: Band Practice Room
description: Also underneath Cripps, this room is wonderfully noise-insulated and has all the equipment you could possibly need to jam out.
In the immortal words of Jeremy Osborne: "Big Beats are the Best".
